text: {"features":[{"name":"Role-specific alignment","description":"How specifically the letter connects the applicant's background and interests to this exact Information Security Engineering role and its stated responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter could largely apply to any software or security role and shows little sign of tailoring to this team's actual work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter is tailored to backend or security work in general but makes only weak or indirect contact with the specific responsibilities in the posting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly connects to at least one core part of the role, such as secure development lifecycle work, vulnerability handling, AI agents, or security automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter ties the applicant's experience to several stated responsibilities and makes a clear case for why this background fits the team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows a sharp understanding of the role's mandate, such as scaling security expertise, automating vulnerability handling, supporting variant analysis, or pairing Go services with Python agents, and directly links that understanding to prior work."}]},{"name":"Foundational systems orientation","description":"The extent to which the letter shows genuine interest in building central tooling and infrastructure whose benefits spread across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no clear indication that the applicant values foundational or organization-wide engineering work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows a general interest in impact or infrastructure but does not clearly frame the appeal of foundational systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly states interest in platform, infrastructure, or broad-impact work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly explains why compounding impact across many teams is motivating and relevant to the applicant's past choices."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents foundational security automation as a deliberate career focus and articulates broad leverage in especially concrete terms, such as inherited improvements, capacity multiplication, or fleet-wide protection."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as making the secure path easier for developers rather than merely policing them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not show empathy for internal users or any clear interest in reducing friction for developer teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses general security interest but gives little sense of helping engineers work more safely or efficiently."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions helping teams, reducing manual work, or improving how security work gets done."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly frames security as enabling busy engineers through better defaults, tooling, or workflow design."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter pairs a strong enablement philosophy with concrete examples of tools or systems that returned expert time, reduced toil, or made secure behavior the easy path."}]},{"name":"Production engineering depth","description":"The depth of experience the letter demonstrates in testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems relevant to backend security tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents only near-minimum production experience, typically a few years and limited breadth of launched or maintained services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter meets the basic experience bar but shows modest scope, such as a small number of services or limited ownership signals."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid mid-level production experience across several services with clear testing, maintenance, and launch responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial production depth through multiple years and several services, with signs of sustained ownership or progression."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows the strongest production track record in the sample, combining longer tenure with repeated launch, maintenance, and operation of many services."}]},{"name":"Go backend fit","description":"How convincingly the letter shows role-relevant experience building back-end systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go only as one language in the background summary and gives no concrete backend work tied to it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter identifies Go as a main language but offers little evidence of what was built with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular production use of Go for services, infrastructure, or backend engineering."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly connects Go to relevant backend systems for security tooling, automation, or internal infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go central to a directly relevant architecture, such as services that constrain agents, implement triage workflows, or support core security systems."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates role-relevant Python experience for automation, tooling, internal services, or AI systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python or gives no credible evidence of using it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python briefly without showing depth, regularity, or production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states routine Python use for tooling, services, automation, analysis, or similar work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial Python ownership in production-grade tooling or internal services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as a major strength, with clear evidence of robust, extensible, role-relevant systems or agents built and operated in it."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic problem solving","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant applies data structures and algorithms effectively to real engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of data structures or algorithms ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter makes only a broad claim of liking algorithms or improving performance without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides one specific example of using a better data structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong applied algorithmic fluency on a nontrivial systems problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows especially strong and current algorithmic judgment through compelling examples that made a problem tractable, streaming, or dramatically faster."}]},{"name":"Production AI experience","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates hands-on experience deploying AI features in production and managing their reliability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of hands-on AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI interest or light exposure but does not show shipped production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states hands-on experience shipping model-backed or LLM-enabled functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter adds clear evidence of production discipline around evaluation, safeguards, hardening, or reliability for AI features."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial production AI experience with nuanced awareness of failure modes and the engineering controls needed to make AI dependable."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems architecture","description":"The extent to which the letter shows direct experience designing agentic systems rather than merely using AI features.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of agentic tooling or multi-step AI system design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter refers vaguely to agents or AI workflows without meaningful architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states direct experience designing agentic systems, pipelines, or tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains a concrete agentic architecture, such as bounded Python agents paired with supervising Go services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows end-to-end, role-matched agentic design thinking, including autonomy boundaries, supervision, auditing, permissions, or explicit task decomposition."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates hands-on experience assessing software or systems for security risk.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no direct evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter signals security interest or credentials but does not show actual assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states experience conducting security assessments, reviews, or threat modeling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete assessment practices such as attack-surface mapping, code review for vulnerability classes, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong hands-on assessment depth and security reasoning, with clear methodology and insight into how assessment work informs better tooling or design."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"How convincingly the letter shows direct experience automating the intake, handling, or routing of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no direct evidence of building vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses interest in reducing security toil but gives no concrete triage or handling system example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that vulnerability report handling or triage was automated."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes specific triage functions such as classification, routing, deduplication, or ownership assignment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a mature automation example that clearly transformed a manual queue or materially reduced expert workload."}]},{"name":"Adversarial security practice","description":"The strength of outside-the-day-job evidence that the applicant actively builds offensive or attacker-minded security skill.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of hands-on security practice beyond general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows a light external security signal, such as an entry-level certification or casual capture-the-flag participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful outside practice through sustained capture-the-flag participation, a stronger certification, or both."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents strong hands-on adversarial evidence, such as OSCP or near-top finishes in competitive capture-the-flag events."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter combines especially strong offensive-practice signals, or explains a demanding signal in especially concrete terms that demonstrate mature attacker-minded skill."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"How much the letter shows ownership of open-source software through maintenance, releases, reviews, or substantial contributions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions occasional upstream patches or minor open-source contributions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular contribution or maintenance responsibility for a project of limited stated reach."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes active maintainership of a used open-source library or project, including review or release work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong community-facing stewardship of an open-source tool or framework with clear ownership of interfaces, releases, roadmap, or user impact."}]},{"name":"Personal project ambition","description":"The degree to which the letter uses self-directed technical projects to demonstrate initiative and appetite for hard engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no personal project or only a very small utility with little technical stretch."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter describes a modest side build mainly for practice, curiosity, or end-to-end completion."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a self-directed project with some nontrivial design or systems choices."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a substantial project that tackles distributed systems, reliability, recovery, or other hard engineering tradeoffs."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents an especially ambitious project built to confront demanding correctness, consistency, or failure-handling problems with unusual seriousness."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter supports claims with concrete, observable evidence rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on generic assertions of skill or fit, with few concrete examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes some concrete claims, but many important abilities remain asserted rather than demonstrated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter supports several key claims with examples, though mechanisms or outcomes stay somewhat general."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter consistently gives specific, believable evidence for major claims by naming systems, techniques, or changes made."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes the case through repeated, crisp, concrete evidence of what was built, how it worked, and why it mattered."}]},{"name":"Narrative integration","description":"How well the letter turns qualifications into a coherent, persuasive story rather than a disconnected list of credentials.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads mainly as a disconnected checklist or a sequence of claims with little persuasive throughline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a basic structure, but the link between motivation, evidence, and role fit remains loose."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a clear case with some synthesis between background, values, and qualifications."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter maintains a strong, coherent throughline that ties examples back to a defined professional motivation and this role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a highly integrated and memorable narrative in which the opening premise, selected evidence, and closing fit reinforce one another."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"The degree to which the letter is free of distracting spelling, grammar, and phrasing problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent spelling, grammar, or wording errors that noticeably distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter contains recurring mechanical errors or awkward phrasing that weaken professionalism but leave the main meaning understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter contains occasional errors or rough phrasing, yet remains easy to follow overall."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is mostly clean and professional, with only minor slips that do not affect credibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is polished, precise, and virtually free of distracting mechanical issues."}]}]}
